servo_echo_audit.meaning: The echo is the commanded PWM position after driver clipping, not a measured shaft/wheel angle.
servo_echo_audit.checked_out_parameter_sign_note: The checked-out vesc.yaml currently says -0.52; these recorded commands agree with +0.52. Recorded behavior is authoritative for this fit.

limitations: The label atan(0.26*yaw_rate/wheel_speed) is a kinematic equivalent angle; slip, effective tire radius, yaw dynamics and trim cannot be separated from linkage geometry.
No cmd_vel or actual front-wheel-angle topic exists in these five recordings; /drive is matched to the executed normalized servo command as a proxy.
The original single holdout was also used to choose PCHIP regularization. This review uses nested selection and an independent held-recording protocol to reduce that optimism.
Temporal cross-validation remains a same-recording estimate. Held-recording error measures transfer to a different run and is more conservative.
The mechanical angle bound is constrained by the INI; the exact linkage curvature inside the observed software saturation limits is not determined.
The known servo command clamp is a separately observed nonlinearity. It does not establish curvature of the mechanical linkage inside that range.

recommendation.model_family: known servo input clamp, affine interior
recommendation.runtime_representation: monotone_pchip with 2 knots; this represents the affine interior exactly and clamps outside
recommendation.reason: Observed software saturation is mandatory. Interior candidate errors are practically tied; use the least-complex curve until measured mechanical wheel-angle data identify linkage curvature.
